# What Drives Me

Hello, my name is Nam-Yoon Kim, and I am an undergraduate researcher at Jeonbuk
National University. I plan to apply to graduate programs for Fall 2027
admission, and I am excited to continue growing as a researcher and taking the
next step in my academic journey.

The three words that best describe the way I approach my goals, studies, and
research are self-motivated, persistent, and resilient.

### Self-Motivated

I believe that having a meaningful goal gives direction to what we do. At this
point in my life, I have a clear goal that I am strongly committed to, and I am
steadily working toward it. I enjoy [**setting goals for myself and taking the
initiative**]{.underline} to move closer to them. Having something meaningful to
pursue motivates me to keep learning, improving, and challenging myself.

### Persistent

To me, [**consistency does not mean making the same amount of progress every
day.**]{.underline} Some days I move forward a lot, while on others, progress may
be small. What matters is [**continuing to show up and move forward without
giving up.**]{.underline} I believe that small efforts, repeated consistently,
eventually lead to meaningful progress.

### Resilient

There have been times when my routine, momentum, or research plans were
disrupted. In those moments, I learned to [**reflect on what was not working and
find my rhythm again.**]{.underline} I have also learned to see [**unexpected
results and failed attempts as opportunities to rethink my
approach.**]{.underline} I hope to become a researcher who can learn from
setbacks, adapt, and continue moving forward.
